title: Desk handover: Korean panel
passage:
I’m leaving this note for whoever takes over the Hall A desk before the Korean panel. The main talk uses channel 2; the panel uses channel 4 for Korean interpretation. The Korean team used channel 4 for its staff test from 11:00 to 11:12. It was not an audience session. The channel was hidden on the sign during the test, but technicians could listen at the desk. For the handover exercise below, look for K on Mira’s badge and W on Louis’s. Those codes identify the wearer, not the sound route. The chair used the booth's blue running-order card during the staff test. It put Dr. Park after the break. Niall's revised order for the actual panel now has Dr. Park speaking before the break.

Niall confirmed that the revised panel start is 11:18; that change did not move the 11:00 test. At the time I’m writing this, the test is over but the booth is still transmitting. Leave that signal available to staff. Put channel 4 on the audience sign when the moderator welcomes the panel audience. The booth technician might signal readiness before the welcome, but that is not the cue to change the sign. Mira is moderating. Louis reads the seating announcement, which can open with the same greeting. On the microphone log, “Requested” is where the operator tried to send the sound. “Heard at” is the return checked after the switch. “Desk” is heard only at the control desk; “Hall” reaches the seated listeners.

The front-row accessibility attendant has just brought the desk a neck loop that the guest has already tried on for size. The guest will listen through her hearing aids at her seat, not through headphones, and will not come to the desk for another trial. Last week a loop cut out on one receiver but sounded clear on another; the first receiver also worked with a different loop. Both the bench and the desk receive the same channel 4 feed. The training receiver and its loop are still running at the bench.

The spare marked L is in the hall locker. A technician heard the booth through headphones on it before lunch. She then heard the same booth through a desk loop on the training receiver. The training receiver stays at the bench; its volume dial sticks. The fitted loop from the attendant arrived after those checks. There’s a hearing-aid test monitor in the desk drawer. It can pick up the loop’s output without the guest having to leave her seat. The level bar on L shows the signal arriving from the booth, even with nothing plugged in. The monitor plays the sound it picks up from any active loop nearby; it has no way to label which loop supplied it. For a test, the side table is out of range of the loop on the bench.

A note on the rehearsal transcript before we print it for the debrief: the reviewer entered ‘After the break, Dr. Park will speak’ under ‘Mistake to discuss with interpreter.’ That line is the reviewer's English rendering of what the interpreter said. The adjacent blank in the transcript is just an unfilled space for the chair's words, not evidence that the chair skipped the announcement. In the actual recording, the chair reads from top to bottom and pauses at the break heading on the blue card.

Here is the drill trace from last week. Use the same sign rule as for this session. At 10:14 K requested Hall; no speech was heard. At 10:16 K requested Hall and said “Welcome to the panel”; the return was heard at Desk. At 10:17 W requested Hall and began “Welcome to the panel”; it was heard at Hall. At 10:19 K requested Hall again and began with the same words; it was heard at Hall. The booth feed was available at the desk throughout.
passageZh:
這張便條留給韓語座談開始前接手 A 廳服務臺的人。主講使用第 2 頻道；這場座談用第 4 頻道提供韓語口譯。韓語團隊在 11:00 至 11:12 使用第 4 頻道做內部測試，並未開放聽眾收聽。測試期間告示牌不顯示該頻道，但技術人員仍可在服務臺收聽。 下文的交接練習中，米拉的識別證是 K，路易是 W。代碼表示佩戴者，不代表聲音送到哪裡。 內部測試時，主席用的是口譯室的藍色流程卡，上面把朴博士安排在休息後發言。奈爾更新了正式座談的流程，朴博士現在改在休息前發言。

奈爾確認座談改在 11:18 開始，原定 11:00 的測試並未因此改期。我寫這張便條時，測試已結束，但口譯室仍在傳送訊號，請讓工作人員繼續收得到。等主持人向座談聽眾致歡迎詞時，再把第 4 頻道顯示在告示牌上。口譯室技術員可能會在主持人致詞前發出就緒訊號，但那不是變更告示牌的時機。 米拉是主持人。路易負責入座廣播，也可能用相同的歡迎詞開頭。麥克風紀錄的「要求送往」指操作員想把聲音送到哪裡；「實際聽到」是切換後監聽核對的結果。「控制臺」表示只有控制臺聽得到；「會場」表示聲音已播給入座的聽眾。

前排的無障礙服務人員剛把來賓試戴合適的頸掛感應圈拿到服務臺。來賓會在座位上使用助聽器收聽，不會戴耳機，也不會到服務臺再試一次。上週有個感應圈插在一台接收器上時會斷音，換插另一台就聽得清楚；第一台接收器換接別的感應圈也正常。 測試臺與服務臺接收的是同一個第 4 頻道訊號。測試臺上的教學接收器及其感應圈仍開著。

標示 L 的備用接收器在廳內置物櫃。技術員午餐前用它接耳機，聽得到口譯室的聲音。接著她用教學接收器搭配服務臺的感應圈，也聽到同一個口譯室。教學接收器的音量旋鈕會卡住，所以留在測試臺。服務人員送來已試戴的感應圈時，這兩次測試都已結束。服務臺抽屜有助聽器測試監聽器，不用請來賓離開座位，就能確認感應圈的輸出。 即使沒有接上任何配件，L 的音量指示條也會顯示從口譯室收到的訊號。監聽器會播放附近任何開著的感應圈傳出的聲音，無法標出訊號來自哪個感應圈。要做測試時，可用感應不到測試臺感應圈的側桌。

排練逐字稿印出來供檢討前，有一點要留意：審閱人員在「要與口譯員討論的錯誤」欄填了「休息後將由朴博士發言」。這句是審閱人員把口譯員的話轉譯成英文。逐字稿旁邊的空白只是還沒填入主席的原話，不表示主席略過了這段宣告。實際錄音中，主席按藍色卡片上的順序從上往下讀，在休息段落的標題處停頓。

 以下是上週交接練習的紀錄。請採用與本次相同的告示牌規則。10:14，K 要求送往會場，沒有聽到說話。10:16，K 要求送往會場並說「歡迎參加座談」；實際在控制臺聽到。10:17，W 要求送往會場，以「歡迎參加座談」開頭；實際在會場聽到。10:19，K 再次要求送往會場，也用相同的話開頭；這次實際在會場聽到。全程都能在控制臺收聽口譯室訊號。
